description: Refreshes a report's data, or only some of its datasheets, then repairs failed calculations and the slides with AI. On a report of another type than SlideDeck, such as a Google Slides presentation, refreshes every sync, or only the `syncIds` given, instead, as Update in the app does, updating its file when it has one (an Email report has none). A run of the whole report then emails it when its email trigger is `all`; a run of only some `syncIds` never does. Answers the run's id at once; while a run of the report is already going, from the API, the app or its schedule, it answers that run's id with started false and starts nothing. Pass repairSlides false to leave the slides as they are, when you wrote them yourself and will check and fix them. From an AI client, a run that emails the report only asks the user to confirm it in Rollstack: it answers `confirmation-required` and runs once they confirm.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

datasheetIds.description: The datasheets to update, from `listReportDatasheets`, instead of the whole report. Each must be a datasheet of this report. Unlike a run of the whole report, which reads every source again, a run of only some datasheets reuses the data last read from their sources: it reads a source again only if that data is missing or expired, or what the datasheet reads has changed, such as its source, its filters or the connection it reads with, as when you replace an uploaded file with `replaceDataset`. If omitted, the run updates the whole report. 1 to 500 ids. Only on reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck`: a report of another type has syncs instead, so passing it returns `400`.

repairSlides.description: Whether Rollstack repairs the slides with AI once the data is in: failed calculations, and text the new data made wrong. Pass `false` to read the data only, when you check and fix the slides yourself. If omitted, the slides are repaired. Only on reports whose `type` is `SlideDeck`.

syncIds.description: The syncs to update, from `listReportSyncs`, instead of the whole report, such as the ones whose `status` is `failed`. Each must be a sync of this report. A `paused` sync is skipped, as in the app. A run of only some syncs never emails the report. If omitted, the run updates the whole report. 1 to 500 ids. Only on reports other than `SlideDeck`, which has datasheets instead, so passing it on a slide deck returns `400`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: startReportRun
title: Start report run
